caveats: Every annotated canopy was used to train or validate the current segmenter, so the segmenter arm is optimistically biased; there is no untouched annotated canopy.
The annotated set was selected by segment/select_field_failures.py as pipeline failures, so it over-represents hard canopies relative to the full field set.
Canopy labels are weak plant-level labels: crops from a leaf_roll canopy inherit leaf_roll even when the individual leaf is asymptomatic.
The field-adapted classifier was fine-tuned on adapt-split canopies, so read the non_adapt and test_only cohorts for it.
